header.title: Industries We Serve
header.subtitle: Tailored cybersecurity solutions built for the unique challenges, compliance requirements, and threat landscapes of your sector.

industries.title: Financial Services
industries.description: Banks, fintechs, and insurance providers face relentless cyber threats and growing regulatory pressure. WHITEGUARD helps financial institutions comply with frameworks like FRA 139, CBE, and SAMA CSF, while enhancing resilience against fraud, data breaches, and ransomware.
bullets: Continuous vulnerability assessment and incident readiness
SOC and SIEM monitoring tailored to financial systems
Compliance alignment with regional and global standards
Employee awareness programs for phishing and fraud prevention

industries.title: Healthcare
industries.description: The protection of patient data and clinical systems is now a matter of life, trust, and compliance. WHITEGUARD enables hospitals, healthcare networks, and medtech providers to meet standards like HIPAA, FDA, and ISO 27001, ensuring sensitive data and connected devices remain protected.
bullets: Data protection and breach prevention across clinical systems
Cloud and IoT device security assessments
Incident response and digital forensics for healthcare environments
Compliance readiness for HIPAA, FDA, and regional data protection laws

industries.title: Manufacturing
industries.description: Modern factories rely on interconnected OT (Operational Technology) and IT systems that, if compromised, can halt production and disrupt global supply chains. WHITEGUARD safeguards industrial networks and critical systems through proactive risk detection, red team assessments, and continuous monitoring.
bullets: Industrial network segmentation and risk assessments
OT/ICS (Industrial Control Systems) cybersecurity audits and compliance with NCA and ISO
Business continuity and incident response plans
Real-time monitoring and threat intelligence for operational continuity

industries.title: Insurance & Leasing
industries.description: As digital platforms reshape the financial ecosystem, insurers and leasing companies are increasingly exposed to data breaches, fraud, and compliance risk. WHITEGUARD supports this sector through data protection, system hardening, and compliance alignment with FRA 139 and PCI-DSS.
bullets: Endpoint and cloud security for underwriting and claims systems
Regulatory mapping for FRA, PCI, and privacy frameworks
Continuous monitoring of customer and transaction data
Executive visibility dashboards through White Hawk

industries.title: Automotive
industries.description: The automotive industry is evolving into a digital ecosystem — connected vehicles, smart factories, and global supply chains. WHITEGUARD helps in source code reviewing for embedded systems, secure cloud integrations, and threat modeling and compliance support.
bullets: Secure software and firmware audits for connected vehicles
Red team and penetration testing for automotive control systems
Supply chain cybersecurity assessments and vendor risk mapping

industries.title: Technology & Cloud
industries.description: In the cloud-first era, every technology company is a potential target. WHITEGUARD works with SaaS providers, datacenters, and cloud operators to secure platforms, APIs, and customer environments against evolving cyber threats.
bullets: Cloud security and configuration audits (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Application and API penetration testing
SOC-as-a-Service and continuous threat detection
Compliance readiness for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and privacy frameworks
